test_title: PYST 14: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

All his friends admired him because he was a __straight shooter__.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **A thoroughly upright straightforward person**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"straight shooter"** means a person who is honest, direct, and forthright in their dealings. (सच्चा और सीधा व्यक्ति) • **Example: **John is known as a straight shooter who always tells the truth. • **"Straight shooter" **refers to someone who is straightforward and trustworthy in their communication and actions. (ईमानदार और स्पष्टवादी व्यक्ति) • **Example: **In business, it's important to be a straight shooter to build long-term relationships. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **A thoroughly upright straightforward person**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Excellent shooter** (उत्कृष्ट निशानेबाज): Someone who is very skilled at shooting. • **Example:** He is an excellent shooter and won the gold medal in the shooting competition. • **Complicated and confusing person** (जटिल और भ्रमित करने वाला व्यक्ति): A person who is difficult to understand or deal with. • **Example:** She can be a complicated and confusing person, making it hard to predict her reactions. • **Moody and pessimistic individual** (मिजाज और निराशावादी व्यक्ति): A person who often changes moods and tends to expect the worst. • **Example:** Being a moody and pessimistic individual, he often finds it hard to stay positive in challenging situations. 35:Tc4a, The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Rejoice**.
